confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of credential stuffing/brute force followed by a successful login from an external IP, immediate privilege escalation, bulk exfiltration of sensitive finance files, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual external IP (185.220.101.45) targeting user_04.
Successful unauthorized login from the same external IP (185.220.101.45) after failed attempts.
Privilege escalation: user_04 successfully elevated their role permissions.
Data exfiltration: bulk download of 11 sensitive files from the finance directory.
Anti-forensics: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide activity.

gaps: Verification of whether user_04 was actually traveling or using a VPN (though the brute force pattern makes this unlikely).
Confirmation of whether the privilege escalation was a system error or a direct exploit.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_04's account via a brute-force attack from an external IP. Following the breach, the attacker escalated privileges, exfiltrated a large volume of finance documents, and deleted system logs to evade detection.
